name: Beast Snagga Boyz
_source_note: Stats, weapons, keywords, composition and points match this datasheet on Wahapedia's 11th edition Orks page, read 2026-10-13. Ability text in data/abilities.json is a summary.
_costing_note: Printed as: 1st to 3rd unit 80 pts for 10 models / 160 pts for 20 models; 4th+ unit 90 pts for 10 models / 170 pts for 20 models.
_composition_note: Printed as: 1-2 Nob models, 9-18 Beast Snagga Boy models. Keyed by unit size, then by modelProfile name; the model mix on the card, and how many of each weapon the unit starts with, follow from it.
_loadout: Every Nob is equipped with: 1 Power Snappa; 1 Slugga. Every Beast Snagga Boy is equipped with: 1 Choppa; 1 Slugga.
_weapons_note: carriedBy names the modelProfile(s) that start with a weapon, so its count follows the unit's size. A weapon with no carriedBy is only ever taken through a wargear option.

melee.name: Choppa - Standard
melee.weaponGroupLabel: Pick one eligible profile before selecting targets. A Hunter profile can only target units with the keywords it names.

_wargearOptions_note: `model` = one pick for every model of that profile; `per` = one pick per that many models in the unit. An add-on rather than a swap: the model keeps its Choppa and Slugga.
